name: create_role
description: Create an AI employee role by researching responsibilities, skills, collaboration patterns, success metrics, and growth paths via Atlassian Rovo knowledge search. Produces a comprehensive role responsibility document.

parameters.name: role_description
parameters.description: High-level description of the role to create (e.g., 'Senior Backend Engineer focused on microservices').

parameters.name: --max-facets
parameters.description: Maximum number of facets to research (caps the breakdown output).

returns: Markdown role responsibility document with sections for responsibilities, skills, collaboration, metrics, growth path, and onboarding plan.
examples: create_role "AI DevOps Engineer specializing in CI/CD and infrastructure automation"
create_role "Senior ML Engineer for recommendation systems" --max-facets 10
